mdRecord.dcterms:title: Finney Family Cemetery
mdRecord.dcterms:description: African American Cemetery. On Falling Branch Road Located 425 yards directly behind 311 Falling Branch Rd. NW. It is in an open field just to the right of a farm road thru the field. It is visible using Google Earth. "Preacher Joe" Finney was a prominent and respected African-American Preacher in Floyd County whose career lasted 63 years. N 36 54.048 W 80 21.778
